summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; valid published/LKG catalog may replay frozen selection against current selected read-set bytes, yielding validator-owned successor context; knowledgeSelectionHash excludes source bytes; knowledgeContextHash binds selection, current source hashes, snapshot, Locator result, decisions, predecessor; authority envelope hash binds ADRs, repository rules, policies, contracts, registries, allowed successor kinds; stale freshness/query-quality failures may degrade unrelated execution if selection, authority, required modules, and read-set verify; publication failures never advance current/LKG or invalidate valid LKG; selection/authority/contract/command-test/policy/protected-path/source-integrity/Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid profile permits same-selection degraded successor only for non-Knowledge self-change, forbids publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release requires current published Knowledge, publication-quality checks, semantic review evidence; extends ADR-0048/0050, supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop interpretation; publication query gate and LKG integrity unchanged; no authority bypass or Knowledge publication authorization.
